description: Configure the Airbnb scraper to extract listings, prices, ratings and host information for any location.

adults.description: Number of adult guests. Affects pricing and availability.
adults.title: Number of Adults

checkIn.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2025-06-01'). Leave empty for general search without dates.
checkIn.title: Check-in Date

checkOut.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2025-06-05'). Leave empty for general search without dates.
checkOut.title: Check-out Date

location.description: The location to search for Airbnb listings (e.g., 'New York', 'Paris, France', 'Tokyo').
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of Airbnb listings to scrape. The scraper returns up to 18 results per search page.
maxItems.title: Maximum Listings

proxy.description: Proxy settings for the scraper. Recommended for large-scale scraping to avoid rate limiting.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Airbnb Scraper Input
